subject: Registration for Distance and animal abundance workshops

messages.author: 12f269733c6eb9a2
messages.subject: Registration for Distance and animal abundance workshops
parts:
To the Distance list:

The early registration deadline for the August distance sampling
workshops in St. Andrews is a week from now (14 July). We are near
capacity of our introductory workshop, and more than 80% filled for our
advanced workshop. We have plenty of seats remaining for our density
surface modelling workshop, which by the way will not be offered in
2008. So, if you were thinking about attending our St. Andrews distance
sampling workshops, we encourage you to register soon.

Let me also draw your attention to an abundance estimation workshop we
are holding in St. Andrews at the end of September
(http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/abundance_workshop/abundance2007.html).
This will examine methods (including distance sampling) to estimate both
open and closed animal populations. We will heavily use WiSP
(http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/estimating.abundance/WiSP/index.html),
the wildlife simulation package to investigate performance of various
types of survey designs and estimators. For distance sampling
practitioners, WiSP offers a way to perform some simple simulations to
gauge the behaviour of distance sampling scenarios.

Lastly, I want you to note that we are now accepting abstracts for the
International Statistical Ecology Conference 9-11 July 2008
(http://www.creem.st-and.ac.uk/isec2008/). We have not yet finalized
all details of the conference, but we have a group of eminent
statistical ecologists who will be presenting exciting talks. Pay a
visit to the website, and put this conference onto your 2008 schedule.

--
Eric Rexstad
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling
University of St. Andrews
St. Andrews Scotland KY16 9LZ
+44 (0)1334 461833
